submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulations across all three candidate mixtures and the full range of allowed gap sizes (1-3 mm), Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.876 ns. This represents a significant improvement over Mixture-G3 (1.355 ns at 2.0 mm) and Mixture-G1 (1.975 ns at 2.0 mm). The standard fluorinated mixture (G2) demonstrates superior performance across all gap sizes tested, with optimal performance at 2.0 mm. This configuration meets all project constraints: it is one of the three approved candidate mixtures, the gap falls within the 1-3 mm specification, the HV system is compatible (up to 12 kV available), and a gas recirculation system with 90% recovery is planned for environmental compliance. The 2.0 mm gap also provides a good balance between manufacturability and performance stability.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 at 2.0 mm gap achieves 0.876 ns time resolution, which is the best result among all 15 simulation runs (3 mixtures × 5 gap sizes). This is superior to G3 (1.355 ns) and G1 (1.975 ns) at the same gap.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is explicitly listed in candidate_specs.md as one of the three candidate gas mixtures (standard fluorinated mixture).

requirements.requirement: The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies
requirements.evidence: According to gas_recirculation.md, a closed-loop recirculation system with 90% recovery is planned for every mixture, including G2, ensuring environmental compliance.
The recommended gap of 2.0 mm falls within the specified range of 1-3 mm.
